title: A Simple Sub-Polynomial Degree Coboundary Expander
summary: High dimensional expanders simultaneously satisfying spectral and combinatorial (coboundary) expansion have recently played a major role in breakthroughs in PCP and coding theory, but the only known construction of such complexes is extremely involved, requiring deep algebraic number theory. In this work, we give an extremely simple combinatorial construction of a sub-polynomial degree complex based on projections of the flags complex (subspace chains) that is (i) a local spectral expander, (ii) a coboundary expander, and (iii) a swap coboundary expander.
